description: Broforce / Broforce Forever (native Linux, GOG build 71321)
long: Broforce is a fast-paced run-and-gun platformer where players control parody action-movie heroes liberating the world from terrorists. Levels feature fully destructible environments and over-the-top explosions. It supports local and online cooperative play for up to four players, plus competitive deathmatch modes.
